plugins.name: Astro
plugins.description: Astro — Michael Andreuzza’s take on the Astro Build palette, dark and light. Palette from https://github.com/michael-andreuzza/astro-theme (MIT).

plugins.name: Bushland
plugins.description: Bushland — earthy, calm and cozy. Palette from https://github.com/michael-andreuzza/bushland (MIT), by Michael Andreuzza.

plugins.name: Cocoa Butter
plugins.description: Cocoa Butter — inspired by artisan chocolate and toasted nuts, in Burnt Chestnut and Almond Cream. Palette from https://github.com/michael-andreuzza/cocoabutter (MIT), by Michael Andreuzza.

plugins.name: Malibu
plugins.description: Malibu — a retro theme inspired by the surfing days in Malibu beach, in Sunset and Sunrise. Palette from https://github.com/michael-andreuzza/malibutheme (MIT), by Michael Andreuzza.

plugins.name: Relentless
plugins.description: Relentless — elegant, simple and electric, in Midnight and Sunset. Palette from https://github.com/michael-andreuzza/relentless (MIT), by Michael Andreuzza.

plugins.name: Sequoia
plugins.description: Sequoia — black, elegant and monochrome, in six variants: Moonlight, Monochrome and Retro, each dark and light. Palette from https://github.com/Sequoia-Theme/vs-code (MIT), by Michael Andreuzza.

plugins.name: Serendipity
plugins.description: Serendipity — an elegant, minimal palette in seven variants. Palette from https://github.com/Serendipity-Theme/vs-code and https://github.com/michael-andreuzza/old-serendipity (MIT), by Michael Andreuzza.
